mars_jezero.method: PROXY. P/PET -> 0: Mars has no liquid precipitation (P = 0) while evaporative demand is non-zero, so the aridity index is 0 by construction (hyper-arid limit).
mars_jezero.proxy_method: definition: P = 0 on a body without liquid precipitation => P/PET = 0 (hyper-arid limit)

moon_south_pole.method: PROXY. No atmosphere and no precipitation: aridity index 0 by construction.
moon_south_pole.proxy_method: definition: P = 0 on a body without liquid precipitation => P/PET = 0 (hyper-arid limit)

mars_jezero.method: Max minus min over 12 Ls bins (30 deg) of the diurnal-mean air temperature from MEDA ATS (median of the three RSM sensors, ~1.45 m), 335 sols of one Mars year. Bin means 212.61..223.93 K. A Mars 'month' (30 deg Ls) lasts ~56 sols vs ~30 days on Earth.

moon_south_pole.method: NOT APPLICABLE. The Moon has no near-surface air; this criterion is excluded from every lunar score (null, never filled).

mars_jezero.method: PROXY. Absolute elevations on different bodies are referenced to unrelated datums and are not physically comparable. The criterion is therefore re-interpreted as 'thin atmosphere': Earth pressure falls with altitude, and no Earth surface reaches Mars or Moon surface pressure, so the target is set to the highest mean elevation of any valid Earth cell (5702.0 m). Similarity on this criterion therefore rewards the lowest-pressure Earth terrain available. MEDA median surface pressure at Jezero ~740 Pa (Earth sea level ~101 325 Pa). Raw MOLA mean elevation of the window -2310 m (areoid) is reported, not used.
mars_jezero.proxy_method: thin-atmosphere reinterpretation: target = maximum mean elevation of valid Earth cells; rewards the lowest-pressure Earth terrain. NOT a comparison of planetary elevations.

moon_south_pole.method: PROXY. Absolute elevations on different bodies are referenced to unrelated datums and are not physically comparable. The criterion is therefore re-interpreted as 'thin atmosphere': Earth pressure falls with altitude, and no Earth surface reaches Mars or Moon surface pressure, so the target is set to the highest mean elevation of any valid Earth cell (5702.0 m). Similarity on this criterion therefore rewards the lowest-pressure Earth terrain available. The Moon has an exosphere only (surface pressure ~0).
moon_south_pole.proxy_method: thin-atmosphere reinterpretation: target = maximum mean elevation of valid Earth cells; rewards the lowest-pressure Earth terrain. NOT a comparison of planetary elevations.

mars_jezero.method: Horn (1981) slope on a 926.6 m grid binned from MGS MOLA 463 m DEM, mean over a 55.6 km x 55.6 km window -- the same code path as Earth.

mars_jezero.method: MEDA TIRS ground temperature, mean over 12 Ls bins of T(13-14 LTST) - T(01-02 LTST): the MODIS Aqua overpass local times.

moon_south_pole.method: Diviner polar hourly bolometric temperature maps (Williams et al. 2019): window mean of T(13-14 h local time) - T(01-02 h), averaged over the summer and winter maps. Bin check: the summer hour14 map equals the mean of the PDS 0.25-h products LTIM53-56 (13.00-14.00 h) to 7e-6 K rms (verified, docs/SCIENTIFIC_AUDIT.md); hour02 follows the same numbering (not separately checked). At the pole 'local time' is solar azimuth; slopes facing away from the Sun give negative differences (p10 summer -21.4 K, p90 172.2 K).

missing_data_rules.earth_value_missing: NaN (or non-finite) Earth value: the criterion is dropped for that cell and the score is renormalised over the remaining active weights; weight coverage is reported. Never imputed.
missing_data_rules.coverage_rule: coverage = sum of active weights with a finite Earth value / sum of active weights; a cell with coverage < 0.80 keeps its score but is not ranked (effective score -1).
missing_data_rules.target_not_applicable: null target value (status N/A): criterion excluded from every score for that target; does not reduce coverage.
missing_data_rules.aridity_undefined: Hargreaves PET = 0 (every monthly mean T < -17.8 C): aridity is NaN, not 0 and not 1.
missing_data_rules.invalid_cell: Not land in GMTED2010 (< 50 % valid 30" pixels) OR no MODIS LST diurnal range OR no POWER T2M: cell excluded from the stack.

verified: Raw input SHA-256 values match between the ingestion sandbox and this repository (inputs[].sha256).

Rebuilding the stack from the raw inputs in an independent environment (Higgsfield sandbox, numpy 2.4.6, zarr-python 3.1.6) reproduced public/data/stack.bin with identical SHA-256; the zarr-python store equalled the npz.
The built-in Zarr v2 writer's output was read back exactly by zarr-python 3.1.6 and xarray 2026.7.0.
Diviner summer hour14 map = mean of PDS LTIM53-56 products (13.00-14.00 h), rms 6.9e-6 K over 794,601 pixels.
JS engine scores are bitwise identical to the Python reference for both targets (tests/test_js_parity.mjs).
unverified: Diviner hour02 bin numbering is assumed to follow hour14 (hour14 = LTIM53-56 was verified; hour02 was not separately checked).
MODIS LST was decoded from NASA GIBS rendered imagery through the published colormap (0.6 K bins); values were not cross-checked against the MYD11C3 HDF science files.
NASA POWER climatology values were taken as served by the API; they were not cross-checked against MERRA-2 files.
Licence statements summarise each provider's published data policy; they have not been legally reviewed.
No analogue ranking has been validated against field studies or expert-selected analogue sites.
manifest.interpretation: Analogue Scores measure similarity of selected modelled variables under a weighting profile. They do not establish geological equivalence, engineering suitability, habitability, safety or mission-site certification.
